CORRECTION to the checker: Cor few's weighted form is not new for fixed K. By Dirichlet's simultaneous approximation theorem (Schmidt LNM 785 Thm 1B), for any K frequencies some q in [1,p-1] has ||q j_i/p|| <= (p-1)^{-1/K} for all i. Since sum y^r <= 1 with r<1 implies sum y <= 1, m(y) <= 2 pi^2 (p-1)^{-2/K} for ANY weights. This matches FMT's tight exponent and beats eq:Kbound's s/((6+s)K). Dirichlet does not give the full K=o(log p) conclusion (only K <~ 2 ln p/((s-1) ln ln p)). A heavy/light split plus Dirichlet also loses a (ln ln p)^{s-1} factor in the upper bound, so the heat-trace argument is still what gives the sharp weighted rate.
